Not synced first: rows imported on anoth.en: Not synced first: rows imported on another device may not show as imported yet.
Not synced first: rows imported on anoth.it: Sincronizzazione non riuscita: le righe importate da un altro dispositivo potrebbero non risultare ancora importate.

Only wallets kept by hand, such as Cash.en: Only wallets kept by hand, such as Cash while you move to statements; never one you import a statement into.
Only wallets kept by hand, such as Cash.it: Solo wallet tenuti a mano, come Cash mentre passi agli estratti; mai uno in cui importi un estratto.
